one_line_description: Five-panel day-cycle guide illustrating rabbit colony behavior across Morning Rush, Midday Window, Evening Rush, Night Velocity, and Dawn Reckoning, with a supplemental four-traffic-cycle reference strip.
Economy reference chart categorizing collectible resources into perishable sustenance, durable sustenance, flexible scrap, rigid scrap, and special artifacts for the MEDIAN colony builder
Lore codex page detailing the five oral Laws of the Median colony culture, with illustrated rabbits and explanatory text about the Story Circle tradition
v0.2 spec sheet comparing the three canon colony species with mechanics, velocity profiles, load capacities, and infrastructure blueprints for Mouse, Rabbit, and Squirrel
Tactical encounter screen showing three squirrels fleeing a hawk ambush with action choices and character stats
Colony event UI screen depicting a Heavy Winds crisis at Rushbottom settlement with action choices and resource stats
Road Work colony encounter screen showing squirrel settlement threatened by construction crews, with action choices and resource stats.
Colony event UI screen depicting a heavy rain flood crisis threatening the lower chambers of Rushbottom settlement beneath a highway culvert
Encounter screen showing a rabbit party contesting wrecked car scrap salvage against a rival mouse band on a rainy highway margin at dusk
RPG-style encounter screen showing three squirrels contesting a berry bush against a raccoon at a highway soundwall
Homecoming encounter screen showing a returning forager party arriving at Rushbottom South Gate at dusk with recovered goods and one injured member
RPG-style expedition launch UI screen featuring a party of anthropomorphic mice departing from a settlement called Rushbottom toward the Margin Path.
Guest Citizen recruitment encounter UI screen showing three rabbits and a wandering hedgehog on a highway median strip at Foxglove Margin
Market exchange encounter card for Rest Stop Metropolis featuring three rabbit party members trading with a broker NPC in a busy highway rest stop marketplace.
Tactical encounter card depicting three armored squirrels in a standoff against a red fox at a riprap spillway
Tactical negotiation UI screen showing three rabbits contesting wrecked car scrap against a rat band on a highway margin
Tactical game UI card depicting three chipmunks negotiating with a rat band over a burst feed sack under an overpass, showing turn options and party stats.
Uncontested resource encounter screen showing a party of six mouse colonists harvesting a wildflower field node in a highway median.
